messages:
Maya (AE): Heads-up team: ZenithHealth approved a POC. They want a locked sandbox, sample clinical notes, automated redaction demo, and clear success metrics. Need owners for ingest creds, redaction approach, eval plan, and a pricing note for potential dedicated capacity.
Ravi (SE): Great. A few clarifying items: 1) expected doc volume for trial? 2) redaction must be deterministic or is flagging OK? 3) do they require zero external egress?
Maya (AE): They expect ~5000 docs (de-identified where possible) over 3 weeks. Redaction should be automatic but flagged for manual QA on borderline cases. They said no cross-border data movement; must stay in NA.
Hannah (SRE): For connectivity our options:
- Customer uploads to a pre-signed S3 bucket we create (fastest)
- Cross-account role with read-only access to a Zenith S3 bucket (better traceability)
- PrivateLink/VPC endpoint into their VPC (best isolation, longer setup)
If they insist on no public egress, PrivateLink is required. Which path do they want?
Sonia (Security): Requirements from our side: signed data processing addendum, KMS-managed encryption keys, strict retention window (<=30 days), audit logs enabled, and we must document redaction limitations (cannot guarantee 100% PHI removal automatically). Legal wants language that human review is required for high-risk PHI before downstream use.
Ibrahim (Product): For success criteria propose: 1) PHI recall >= 85% on automated detection (measured over 300 eval docs) 2) median completion latency <= 350ms for 256-token prompts 3) end-to-end pipeline uptime >= 99% during test window 4) redaction precision not lower than 90% to avoid over-masking useful clinical data.
Ravi (SE): I'll craft 3 prompt families + 25 eval examples each:
- clinical-summary (handoff style)
- triage-symptom-extract (structured output)
- redaction-test (edge PHI cases)
Will also include human-rating template (1-5 scale for correctness, missing PHI, and utility). ETA Tue EOD.
Hannah (SRE): On storage I can provision s3://poc-zenith-temp with SSE-KMS, object lock disabled, and CloudTrail object-level logging. infra-bot can make short-lived STS creds. Post their AWS account ID and TTL.
infra-bot: I can create the bucket prefix and role. Please provide Zenith account ID and TTL (hours). Default TTL=8h.
Sonia (Security): Additions: need to know whether any docs contain social security numbers or full MRNs. If yes, we require an extra manual redaction step before upload or encrypted staging with access limited to approved reviewers.
Maya (AE): I'll ask Zenith about SSNs/MRNs and confirm whether they can pre-redact. Also will request their AWS account for cross-account role if they prefer that.
Ibrahim (Product): For redaction approach recommend layered pipeline: 1) deterministic regex & dictionary masks (SSN, phones, emails) 2) NER model tuned for med entities 3) fallback rule-based masking and confidence scoring that triggers manual review. I'll write a short playbook snippet we can share.
Ravi (SE): Example snippet to include in playbook:
```
# pseudocode redaction flow
for doc in docs:
  doc = regex_mask(doc, patterns=[ssn,email,phone])
  entities = ner_model.predict(doc)
  for e in entities:
    if e.type in PHI_TYPES and e.confidence > 0.75:
      mask(e.span)
    else:
      flag_for_review(e.span, e.confidence)
```
Hannah (SRE): Timeline and owners suggested:
- Mon: security sign-off checklist (Sonia)
- Tue: SE delivers prompts + evals (Ravi)
- Wed: infra sets up bucket/roles (Hannah + infra-bot)
- Thur: customer uploads sample data (Zenith)
- Week 2: run evals, iterate prompts
- Week 3: finalize results and demo
If PrivateLink chosen, add 1 week to the schedule.
Maya (AE): Action list: Ravi -> prompts/evals Tue EOD. Sonia -> security checklist + any gaps Mon EOD. Hannah -> draft connectivity options + estimate Mon. I'll confirm SSN/MRN presence and ask for AWS account ID. Also need a quick pricing note for a small dedicated pool if they want sustained throughput during production (estimate to hand to buyer).
Sonia (Security): Also confirm deletion process: immediate deletion on request + automated purge at 30 days. Add verification steps: snapshots/logs retention policy spelled out for legal.
Ibrahim (Product): I'll assemble pass/fail rubric and sample dashboard metrics (latency distribution, PHI recall/precision, eval human scores).
Maya (AE): Sounds good. I'll open an internal onboarding ticket with these owners and ask Zenith to sign the DPA + data addendum before we provision anything.
Ravi (SE): I'll attach the prompt templates to the ticket and include the human rating sheet.
Hannah (SRE): If they want VPC peering/private link we should schedule a 30min network call. Suggest Fri 11am PT.
Maya (AE): I'll propose both Fri 11am and Wed 3pm to their infra team. Thanks everyone :pray:
